summary.text: Shane Ferguson is the Libertarian candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 96 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a security guard and U.S. Army National Guard veteran who holds a graduate degree from Webster University.

paragraphs.text: Shane Ferguson served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2005 to 2013, graduated from Washington High School, and earned a graduate degree from Webster University in 2025.
His listed career experience includes working as a security guard.
He advanced from the Libertarian Party primary on August 4, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Ferguson described himself as a veteran, father, husband, paralegal graduate, security guard, writer and filmmaker.

He listed lower taxes, voter sovereignty and less government interference in citizens' daily lives as his key messages, and said he is against gerrymandering and against the overturning of citizen-initiated measures that have passed.
